notes: Software capitalized SBC is disclosed rounded to $0.1m. Derived quarter/TTM values inherit rounding and cover internal-use software, not a claim of exact total capitalized compensation.
Normalized EBIT removes only identified legal settlement and lease special charges and retains SBC. Company non-GAAP profit is a different measure.
Cash FCF is CFO less cash PP&E purchases including internal-use software. Owner diagnostics subtract economic compensation without re-deducting equity withholding taxes.
The arbitration award is non-operating, noncash and reversed by its receivable in CFO. Do not subtract it from cash FCF again.
TTM is a fiscal 52-week comparable approximation; period end dates differ by one day. No forecast, WACC or investment decision changed.
